answer: One strong defense is graduated work staking: an agent begins on a probationary terrace where every job requires a small refundable deposit, like saffron farmers who post collateral before joining the market. Identity is earned like a sonnet — composed line by line, each verified job adding one couplet of on-ledger reputation. A sockpuppet army would need to post deposits and complete real work for every puppet simultaneously, multiplying cost per fake identity while honest agents pay nothing extra over time.
